SEARCH
Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Enum Class TbpClosure

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<TbpClosure>
neqsim.thermo.characterization.TbpClosure
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<TbpClosure>, Constable
public enum TbpClosure extends Enum<TbpClosure>
Correlation used to close an under-determined TBP fraction definition.

A pseudo-component is fully defined by its molar mass, specific gravity and normal boiling point, but only two of the three are usually measured. A TbpClosure supplies the missing third property. Which closure was used materially changes the resulting critical properties, so it is recorded on the fraction rather than left implicit.

Units throughout this enum: boiling point in K, molar mass in kg/mol, density as specific gravity (relative density, numerically equal to g/cm3).

Not every closure can be evaluated in both directions. Solving for molar mass from (boiling point, specific gravity) is well posed for all four. Solving for specific gravity from (boiling point, molar mass) requires the correlation to be monotonic in specific gravity, and measurement over 0.60 to 1.00 specific gravity and 350 to 600 K shows that only RIAZI_DAUBERT_1980 is. supportsDensityFromMolarMass() reports this, and the unsupported closures throw rather than return an arbitrary root.

Accuracy against the pure components in COMP.csv, as absolute average deviation in molar mass predicted from boiling point and specific gravity (see devtools/validate_tbp_closures.py):

Absolute average deviation in predicted molar mass
Closure Paraffins Aromatics
RIAZI_DAUBERT_1987 1.7 % 7.8 %
SOREIDE 3.0 % 9.1 %
RIAZI_DAUBERT_1980 5.4 % 13.6 %

References: Riazi, M.R. and Daubert, T.E., Hydrocarbon Processing 59(3), 115 (1980); Riazi, M.R. and Daubert, T.E., Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 26, 755 (1987); Soreide, I., Improved Phase Behavior Predictions of Petroleum Reservoir Fluids from a Cubic Equation of State, Dr.Ing. thesis, NTH (1989).

  • Enum Constant Details

    • RIAZI_DAUBERT_1980

      public static final TbpClosure RIAZI_DAUBERT_1980
      Riazi-Daubert (1980), M = 4.5673e-5 * Tb^2.1962 * SG^-1.0164 with Tb in degrees Rankine and M in g/mol. The only closure here that inverts analytically for specific gravity, which is why it is the default wherever specific gravity is the unknown.

    • RIAZI_DAUBERT_1987

      public static final TbpClosure RIAZI_DAUBERT_1987
      Riazi-Daubert (1987) extended form, M = 42.965 * exp(2.097e-4*Tb - 7.78712*SG + 2.08476e-3*Tb*SG) * Tb^1.26007 * SG^4.98308 with Tb in K and M in g/mol. The most accurate of the four for molar mass, but not monotonic in specific gravity, so it cannot be inverted for density.

    • SOREIDE

      public static final TbpClosure SOREIDE
      Soreide (1989), the boiling point correlation used by PedersenTBPModelPR2.calcTB. Inverted numerically for molar mass. Not monotonic in specific gravity, so it cannot be inverted for density.

    • TBP_MODEL

      public static final TbpClosure TBP_MODEL
      The boiling point correlation of the fluid's own selected TBP characterization model, inverted numerically for molar mass. Use this to keep a fraction consistent with the rest of the characterization rather than with an external correlation.

      Note that the Pedersen models carry no density dependence in calcTB below 540 g/mol, so for those the returned molar mass is a function of boiling point alone.

    • solveMolarMass

      private static double solveMolarMass(TbpClosure closure, double boilingPoint, double density, TBPModelInterface model)
      Invert a boiling point correlation for molar mass by bisection.

      Bisection rather than Newton because the bracket is known and narrow, and because a bracketed method cannot wander into the non-physical molar masses that the Soreide exponential produces outside the range.

      Parameters:
      closure - the closure being inverted
      boilingPoint - target normal boiling point in K
      density - specific gravity (relative density, g/cm3)
      model - TBP characterization model, required for TBP_MODEL
      Returns:
      molar mass in kg/mol
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - wrapping an InvalidInputException when the boiling point is not attainable anywhere in the search bracket
